name: @kkier/things-mcp
description: Minimal, token-light Things 3 MCP server. Direct-SQLite reads, URL-scheme writes, native Streamable HTTP + stdio. MCP SDK v2 + Zod v4.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --target bun --outdir dist --sourcemap --external @modelcontextprotocol/server --external @modelcontextprotocol/core --external zod && printf '#!/usr/bin/env bun\n' | cat - dist/index.js > dist/index.tmp && mv dist/index.tmp dist/index.js
